source: fierymud_legacy/src: cleric.cpp, sorcerer.cpp, sorcerer.hpp, rogue.cpp, rogue.hpp, warrior.cpp, mobact.cpp (mob_attack class switch, check_mob_status), ai_utils.cpp (mob_heal_up)
notes: Rules are per FAMILY; 'classes' maps Class.plain_name to the families it runs, in order. Hybrids run cleric rules first, then warrior rules (mob_attack falls through), so the warrior family uses priority 500+.

Each rule names an Ability.plain_name. The seeder only creates a ClassAiRules row when the class has that ability in ClassAbilities (spells, songs, chants) or ClassSkills (skills; its min_level becomes ClassAiRules.min_level).

priority is legacy array order (lower first). chance_pct is 0-100. conditions use the mob_ai_rules.rs JSON keys only. target is one of auto, self, tank, weakest_attacker, caster, most_buffed, lowest_ally, room.
Engine contract: skip a buff the mob already has and a hindrance the target already has; apply the 'best 2-3 attempts' cap; legacy 'victim level < mob level + 20' for hindrances.
'legacy' on a rule is documentation only and is not written to the database.

align applies to the TARGET's alignment band; not_align negates it; self_align is the caster's own band (a list means any of them). When a rule targets the mob itself, target-side conditions read the mob's current opponent (legacy 'victim').
level_scaled_chance passes with level% once per mob per round (shared by every rule asking), as legacy rolled once per class AI call; chance_pct is then the rule's share of the scaled roll.

Every rule has a stable key: 'key' when given (needed where a family repeats an ability), else '<family>:<ABILITY>' (race rules '<RACE>:<ABILITY>'). The database seed_key is '<Class.plain_name>/<key>' for class rules and the key itself for race rules, so renumbering a priority updates the row instead of duplicating it. Keys must stay unique and must never be reused for a different rule.

retired_families: rules removed from the seed (same shape as families). Only their class mapping is used: a keyless database row that still matches one is claimed and then disabled by the next step, so a dropped rule does not stay enabled in databases seeded earlier. Never list a rule here that is also in families.
race rule min_level gates the rule on the mob's level (a level 3 demon must not breathe).
race_rules are per Race enum and run ahead of the class rules; level_roll bands share one roll per mob per round (legacy dragonlike_attack).

gaps.resolved: target_hp_above, self_align, not_align, not_lifeforce, target_level_max, specific self_has_debuff, requires_shield, requires_weapon_type, outdoors, level_scaled_chance and the dragon / demon race rules (RaceAiRules) are all expressed now.
approximations: DIVINE_RAY: legacy needs caster alignment > 650; seeded as good (>= 350).
class alignment gates of Diabolist / Priest / Paladin / Ranger / Anti-Paladin (cleric_ai_action) are not seeded.
warrior / rogue band chances are the legacy bands' static shares; the level gate itself is level_scaled_chance.
dropped: BODYSLAM (warrior): legacy opener on a standing victim; the engine runs no skills for a mob at peace, so the rule could never fire.

ANIMATE_DEAD (sorcerer): legacy animates a corpse 10+ levels under the mob; a room-targeted rule with no opponent never resolves, and a self-targeted bare cast would spawn corpse-less skeletons every pulse.
Still inert for the same reason (skills with out_of_combat): rogue THROATCUT / STEAL / HIDE; mob hide runs on the mob pulse instead.

mob_sorcerer_area_spells; only when the victim is grouped, best two

bard.legacy: legacy roll>95 (4%) of the level gate; needs a piercing weapon and not tanking (engine)
legacy gates the whole bard AI on rand(0..101) < level (level_scaled_chance, one shared roll per round); heals under 30% HP while the victim is above 20%
mob_bard_hindrances in order, one attempt (engine skips effects the victim already has)
check_bard_status cures (10% cancel in combat); self_has_debuff names the debuff the remover answers to
mob_bard_buffs, in or out of combat

rogue.legacy: legacy: act only when rand(0..101) < level (level_scaled_chance, one shared roll per round), then pick by the scaled roll band; chance_pct is the band's share: roll>95 = 4%; needs a piercing weapon, not tanking (engine)
roll>94 (about 5%), opener only (mob not yet fighting), piercing weapon
roll>70, only vs the current opponent and not already cornering (about 25% of what is left)
legacy: only reached if the mob has no kick
mob_steal; legacy chance = steal skill %, target must be within level+5

warrior.legacy: bash a casting player grouped with the tank; needs a shield (requires_shield), size within -1..+2 (engine); legacy passes when skill >= random(25,60), always for skilled mobs
roll>75 while fighting (24%); the legacy HITALL skill is HIT_ALL in the DB
mercenaries; roll>95, piercing weapon, not tanking (engine)
roll > 80 - bash/2 (-20 vs casters): about 55% for a skilled mob; needs a shield (requires_shield), standing victim of fitting size, no NOBASH
